cases.question: 总结苹果公司 2026 年第二季度的财务表现。

evidence.content: Apple Q2 FY2026 net sales were $111,184 million versus $95,359 million; net income was $29,578 million versus $24,780 million; diluted EPS was $2.01. Services net sales were $30,976 million. Six-month operating cash flow was $82,627 million.

cases.question: What does Apple report about cash flow in Q2 2026?

evidence.content: Apple Q2 FY2026 six-month operating cash flow was $82,627 million. Cash paid for income taxes, net was $20,397 million. These are distinct metrics.

cases.question: Compare Tesla and NVIDIA revenue performance.

evidence.content: Tesla Q2 2025 total revenue was $22,496 million. The filing is a Q4/FY2025 update containing the historical Q2 column.
NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, and Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion.

cases.question: 比较特斯拉和英伟达的营收表现。

evidence.content: 特斯拉 Q2 2025 总营收为 $22,496 million；该文件是包含 Q2 历史列的 Q4/FY2025 更新。
英伟达 2027 财年第一季度营收为 $81.6 billion，数据中心营收为 $75.2 billion。

cases.question: 英伟达 2027 财年第一季度的数据中心业务表现如何？

evidence.content: NVIDIA 2027 财年第一季度数据中心营收为 $75.2 billion，同比增长 92%；同期总营收为 $81.6 billion。
